what_changed: Net GEX: flipped sign from +5,227 to -1,252, the first negative strip reading in 8 sessions; the ATM band stayed positive at +3,088 but fell from +5,718.
Gamma flip: lost entirely - the cumulative curve crossed zero at 1090 on each of the prior two sessions and now never crosses inside the 910-1150 grid.

S50U26.five_day_thesis: Five sessions ago (09-22) spot was 1079.3 with +10,466 strip GEX and a 1080 gamma flip; today it is 1075.2 with -1,252 and no flip anywhere in the grid, an 11,718-point collapse in dealer gamma into the last day. The 1070 max pain never moved across any of it, extending a 17-session run while spot oscillated between 1075.2 and 1083.1 around it. Call OI drained 675 lots to 17,755 and the 1100 wall shed 179 to 2,539, while put OI added 541 to 46,090, so P/C OI climbed 2.47 to 2.60 purely through call-side unwind. The near put wall migrated up 20 points from 1050 to 1070, pulling active support onto the max-pain strike itself. ATM IV traced 12.48, 13.49, 13.22, 10.43, 11.08, 16.36, but DTE-adjusted that path is monotone premium decay, not a volatility event.

strategies.name: 1070/1050 put debit spread (settlement-risk hedge)
strategies.rationale: A 2.0-point debit (1070 put at 2.2 ask against 1050 put at 0.2 bid) buys exactly the tail a -1,252 strip GEX cannot absorb: below the -4,228 gamma node at 1070 dealer hedging amplifies the move instead of fading it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the 2.0-point debit; max value 20 points if the index settles at or below 1050.
strategies.invalidation: A settlement at or above 1070 expires the structure worthless.

strategies.name: 1080/1090 call credit spread
strategies.rationale: A 1.3-point credit (1080 call at 2.0 bid against 1090 call at 0.7 ask) sells the +2,812 and +3,668 positive-gamma nodes where dealer hedging dampens, with 1070 max pain 10 points below the short strike and 5.2 points of upside needed just to reach it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 10-point width minus 1.3-point credit = 8.7 points; breakeven 1081.3.
strategies.invalidation: A print above 1081.3 erases the credit; above 1090 is full max loss.

S50U26.prediction: The 04:39 book priced an 80% settlement window of 1060-1090, with the 1070 anchor 5.2 points below spot and the 1080 dampening node 4.8 points above, pointing at a 1070-1080 settlement band rather than a directional resolution. With strip GEX at -1,252, a break below the 1070 put node was the one tail the book could not absorb - that is where dealer hedging would have amplified rather than fought the move. The invalidation was any decisive move outside 1060-1090; the settled print is not in this dataset, and S50Z26 is now the front series.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice and not an instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery to force a pin and pinning is structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 17-session 1070 anchor as a tendency, not a settlement guarantee. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the 8.7-point max loss on the call spread is real and short-vol payoffs are negatively skewed. Quoted bids and asks are from the 04:39 +07 pre-open snapshot and the expiry print is not included.
